effective_rank_tests.trace: log det(I+A)<=Tr(A), so H(p_N)+(1/2)sum_z p_z Tr(A_(N,z))=o(N^3) is sufficient.
effective_rank_tests.rank_norm: log det(I+A)<=rank(A)log(1+||A||_op), so H(p_N)+(1/2)sum_z p_z rank(A_(N,z))log(1+||A_(N,z)||_op)=o(N^3) is sufficient.
effective_rank_tests.small_excess: If the cutoff dimension d_N=Theta(N^3), sup_z||A_(N,z)||_op=o(1), and H(p_N)=o(N^3), then the average log determinant is o(N^3).
effective_rank_tests.low_rank: Uniformly bounded relative covariance excess supported on weighted effective rank o(N^3) is coefficient-rigid even with label-dependent rotated eigenspaces and arbitrary translations.
effective_rank_tests.scope_guard: These are sufficient conditions, not necessary thresholds. Fixed order-one excess on a positive fraction of all cutoff modes can have order-N^3 capacity and remains unresolved by this theorem.
